# Snipfolio

> Screenshot clipping and composition for developers and designers.

Snipfolio is a web app for clipping rectangular regions ("snips") from screenshots and composing them into polished, export-ready images with device frames, captions, and custom backgrounds. It is designed for developers and designers who need clean screenshot exports for documentation, app stores, marketing sites, and presentations — without needing Figma or another design tool.

## Core workflow

1. Drop a PNG or JPEG screenshot into the app.
2. Draw crop regions ("snips") on the image. Snips snap to desktop (3:2) or mobile (9:16) aspect ratios for perfect device frame alignment.
3. Compose one or more snips into a layout — choose a background, add a device frame (desktop, mobile, or browser chrome), and write optional captions.
4. Export the finished composition as a PNG.

## Key features

- Visual drag-to-crop tool with aspect-ratio snapping
- Device frames: laptop, phone, browser chrome (SVG overlays matched to crop ratios)
- Single and auto-collage composition layouts
- Custom backgrounds
- Optional captions per snip
- Works without an account (no uploads; data stays in the browser tab)
- Cloud save for signed-in users (compositions persist across sessions)

## Pricing

- **Free**: Core snipping and composition with watermarked exports
- **Day Pass** ($4.99, one-time): 24-hour full access with no watermarks
- **Pro** ($9.99/mo): No watermarks, unlimited saved compositions, and access to Pro-only features

## Target audience

- Developers writing README files, docs, or changelogs who need polished screenshots
- Designers preparing app store screenshots or marketing assets
- Product teams creating feature announcements

## Technology

Web application built with Nuxt 4, Vue 3, and Tailwind CSS. Works in any modern browser. No installation required.
